title: The Day I Plunged Into Rough Waters

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Thump. Thump. Thump... My heart is
pounding. The sweat sticking to
my back
feels gross. Knowing that one choice here
is gonna change
my whole damn life... It's
got me nervous. Hesitant. Lost.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, I feel like trash, but I feel so alive.
And now—the cards are
down. Let's get
this blood-chilling game started.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's been a couple months since I started
working at Tracen Academy.
I haven't
done anything of much interest yet, but I
think I've pretty
much got the hang of
things.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The town, on the other hand, is still fairly
new to me. I figure I might
as well have a
walk around and get to know the place,
but...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
There's graffiti all around, and the narrow
street ahead hardly seems
inviting. I start
turning around, looking for a way back to
the main
street, when—

text_block_list.name: Delinquent A
text_block_list.text:
Get back here! I know you. You're that
Nakayama punk who used to
raise hell
'round here!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Teen
text_block_list.text:
Tch. I left that life behind me. Don't go
tryin' to drag me back.

text_block_list.name: Head Delinquent
text_block_list.text:
Say what you want, but everyone 'round
here knows what you've
done. Even the
boss says you've got guts—more than us,
his own boys.

text_block_list.name: Head Delinquent
text_block_list.text:
Y'wanna know what he said when I told
him I'd take you down? "No
one plays the
game like that risk-junkie. Give it up or
you'll get your
ass handed to you." ...But I
ain't forgivin' you that easy.

text_block_list.name: Head Delinquent
text_block_list.text:
It's your fault everyone's lookin' down on
us! So quit pretendin' you've
gone clean
and let's settle this!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As the man gets riled up, I see the
Umamusume's ears droop back.
Next thing
I know, I'm running out between the two.

text_block_list.name: Delinquent A
text_block_list.text: The hell?!

text_block_list.name: Delinquent A
text_block_list.text: Hey... Is that idiot really gonna take Nakayama's place? They don't look like they've played chicken ever!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After running my big fat mouth, the
delinquents pulled me out to
some pier for
a game of chicken.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And now I'm sat on one of their
motorcycles, the rumble of the engine

reverberating through my core. One of
them hands me his helmet, and
I slide it
on.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Teen
text_block_list.text:
Hey. Your hands are shaking. Are you sure
you can drive that?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Teen
text_block_list.text:
If you've got cold feet, no one'll blame
you if you run. I mean, I'm a
complete
stranger. You don't owe me anything.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Teen
text_block_list.text:
Well, wouldn't be the first time a
well-intentioned idiot pulled a stunt
like
this. Why do people like you keep jumping
headfirst into
danger?

text_block_list.name: Head Delinquent
text_block_list.text:
Listen up—the rules're simple. We both
drive straight at the sea, and
whoever
chickens out and hits the brakes first loses.

text_block_list.name: Head Delinquent
text_block_list.text:
You prove you've got guts, and I swear
we'll leave your new pal
Nakayama alone.
That good with you?

text_block_list.name: Head Delinquent
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I keep my word. Assumin' you're still
alive when I'm done with
you.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Teen
text_block_list.text:
Tch. Quit tryin' to freak the poor idiot out.

Hey, you. Take a deep breath and listen to
me for a sec.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Teen
text_block_list.text: If you get scared and start thinkin' maybe it's time to brake, it's not. Don't hesitate, just keep going. The line between life and death is just a line in the sand.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Teen
text_block_list.text: If you're gonna do this, you've gotta throw out any doubts now. Lighten up, and ride free. Don't think about anything but winning—and keep fighting.

text_block_list.name: Delinquent A
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, psych yourself up all you want, but
we all know you're not
really gonna floor
it. Just don't embarrass yourself too bad.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The delinquents look me over, grinning
smugly. Then, the guy
refereeing our
contest comes over behind us, and tosses a
rock to be
our starting signal.

text_block_list.name: Head Delinquent
text_block_list.text: DRIVEEE!

text_block_list.name: Delinquent A
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! That idiot's really going for it?!
They're goin' way too fast!

text_block_list.name: Delinquent A
text_block_list.text:
HEY, IDIOT! You got a death wish or
somethin'?!

text_block_list.name: Head Delinquent
text_block_list.text:
Tch. You're crazy. I'm not goin' down with
you! ...Dammit!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I slam the brakes, way closer to the water than that chicken got. The motorcycle skids with a screech, just feet—inches from...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
There's a lurch as the wheel drops off the
edge and the bike flips,
shooting into the
air. The blood boiling in my veins freezes
in an
instant.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Teen
text_block_list.text: HOLD YOUR BREATH!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's like time stopped. Everyone's frozen
solid—except the
"Nakayama" girl
charging towards me. She gains speed with
each
step, leaping off the pier like she's
taking flight.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Teen
text_block_list.text: HRAAAAH!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She grabs on to the back of my shirt and yanks, hard. I'm pulled off the bike, choking for air, as it plunges into the sea.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Teen
text_block_list.text: Panting... Hah. Hahaha! Well, this sucks. We're both soaked!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Teen
text_block_list.text: Hah... But we're alive. Haha... Damn. My heart's still going wild.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Teen
text_block_list.text: Ah... Hehehe. You just drove off the pier, and your first worry is the game? Man, you're outta your mind. Just look!

text_block_list.name: Head Delinquent
text_block_list.text: Hey, jump in and grab the bike! Hurry!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Teen
text_block_list.text:
You got them scrambling—I'd say that's a
win. C'mon, let's ditch 'em!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Teen
text_block_list.text:
You should be able to figure out your way
home from here, right? See
ya.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Teen
text_block_list.text:
I swear, I haven't had a thrill like that in a
while. Haha...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I want to thank her properly for saving me,
but she doesn't turn back.
She just lifts a
hand and waves, walking off into the night.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Time passes, but the sensation of flying off
that pier doesn't. I keep
going back to
that alley, but I never find her. At this
point, I'm half
convinced I dreamed the
whole thing up, but then...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Teen
text_block_list.text: ...Sigh.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's her. Right here at the Tracen tryouts!
